summary: A wooden octagonal tower on Northumberland Strait, lit in 1870, kept by the Bent family, retired when the Confederation Bridge opened in 1997.

notes_for_editor: Most detail rests on LighthouseFriends (secondary, summarising Marine reports for 1869-1914); original annual reports for 1869-1899 are not in the corpus, so those facts are not independently verified. Keeper tenures after 1901 are LighthouseFriends dates only; Percy Bent matched by name in the 1905/1906 staff tables (OCR column position). The Lady Speedwell page number is a scan page; printed page not confirmed. Parks Canada heritage-lighthouse page did not load; statement of significance read via HistoricPlaces.
